skill.summary: Provides canonical information, trusted references, and market data links for the PORTAL token.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Portal Token Discovery skill.
- Provides canonical network addresses for the PORTAL token across Base, Ethereum, and Solana.
- Supplies trusted references: CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, official website, BaseScan, and X (Twitter) account.
- Includes main trading pair information on Aerodrome (Base/USDC).
- Offers instructions for retrieving live price, volume, market cap, and circulating supply from CoinGecko.
- Emphasizes information delivery only—no trading functionality included.
